given: no stock record yet exists for a given SKU at a given physical location
when: a warehouse operator files that SKU at that location with a quantity
then: a stock record for that (SKU, location) pair exists, and retrieving it returns the SKU, location, and quantity exactly as filed
architectural_notes: Lives at the API boundary: a file (POST/PUT) then a read (GET) against the JSON stock endpoint, verified through the pytest-bdd suite hitting the paired Lakebase branch. The boundary (app/routes) validates the payload and delegates to app/services, which calls app/repositories to persist and read back the Stock row (app/models/stock.py). Cross-cutting: request validation owned at the boundary; the (sku,location) uniqueness invariant (PI1) is enforced in the DB, not the domain. No business logic in the boundary; the repository is the only layer touching the session.
